title: Loan Amount Record Error: Larkspur's Share of a Closing and Funding Per Diem Shortfall
content:
**Clause.** Larkspur absorbs part of a Closing and Funding per diem shortfall that its closing record's loan amount created. The allowance is read from the closing record and from the borrower's Mortgage Loan File (its loan amount, its base loan amount, its program's upfront program fee percent and whether the file is exempt from that fee):

| Condition | Larkspur absorbs |
|---|---|
| the closing record's loan amount equals the loan file's base loan amount, and the file's program finances an upfront program fee (a fee percent above zero) from which the file is not exempt, so the financed fee was left off the record | 10.00 |
| the closing record's loan amount differs from both the loan file's loan amount and its base loan amount | 5.00 |
| any other case | nothing for the loan amount |

Amounts are in US dollars. Any record-error allowance comes off the per diem shortfall first, the remainder rounded half up to the cent and never below zero.

## Combinations (hypothetical file: base loan amount 300,000.00, loan amount 305,250.00 after a financed upfront fee of 1.75 percent)

| Closing record's loan amount | File exempt from the upfront fee? | Larkspur absorbs |
|---|---|---|
| 300,000.00 | No | 10.00 |
| 300,000.00 | Yes | nothing (equals the base amount but no financed fee applies; it does not differ from the base amount) |
| 305,250.00 | No | nothing (matches the loan file's loan amount) |
| 302,000.00 | No | 5.00 |

For a file whose program carries no upfront program fee (fee percent zero), a closing record showing the base loan amount equal to the file's loan amount absorbs nothing.
